facts.fact: Third-party Ipsos research, as summarized by Think with Google, found that local searches can convert more than 2x as often as non-local searches.
facts.quote: Ipsos found that local searches happen at all phases of the purchase cycle and can convert more than 2x as often as non-local searches

facts.fact: The page states that immediate-need transactional queries such as 'plumber near me' usually trigger a map pack with three listings.
facts.quote: usually trigger a map pack with three listings, directions options, local service ads, and, increasingly, AI-style summaries

facts.fact: The page says four signals usually turn a normal search into a local one: a place name, 'near me' phrasing, a search on a phone, and a category that maps to a physical place.
facts.quote: Four signals usually turn a normal search into a local one.

facts.fact: The page states that Google's local ranking logic comes down to three factors: relevance, distance, and prominence.
facts.quote: Google’s local ranking logic still comes down to **relevance, distance, and prominence**.

facts.fact: Adwave states that it creates and runs ads on TV, search, and social.
facts.quote: Adwave creates and runs ads on TV, search, and social.

facts.fact: Adwave lists six local search metrics it calls the useful ones to track: Google Business Profile impressions, map-pack views, clicks to call, direction requests, website visits from GBP, and branded search lift over time.
facts.quote: The useful ones are Google Business Profile impressions, map-pack views, clicks to call, direction requests, website visits from GBP, and branded search lift over time.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends reviewing GBP Insights, GA4, Search Console, and Adwave campaign attribution together each week.
facts.quote: review GBP Insights, GA4, Search Console, and Adwave campaign attribution together each week

facts.fact: Adwave's local search KPI table gives each KPI a 30-day signal and a 90-day target.
